diagnosis: Uterine tumour resembling ovarian sex cord tumour
legend: Tumour cells are usually small and form (A) trabeculae, (B) cords, or (C) tubules. Variant cytomorphology includes (D) rhabdoid and (E) vacuolated/lipidized. (F) Immunohistochemically, tumour cells are often positive for calretinin.
